## Affected App(s)

- [ ] `client` (customer portal)
- [ ] `ops` (operations dashboard)
- [ ] `agents` (field agent PWA)
- [ ] `web` (public website)
- [ ] Shared package (`packages/*`)

## Feature Description

A clear description of what you want and why it is needed.

## Motivation

What user problem or business need does this address?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you'd like it to work. Include UI/UX sketches or API contract changes if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you considered and why they were rejected.

## Potential Impact

- New environment variables or SSM parameters required?
- New backend API endpoints or changes to existing ones?
- New shared package dependencies?
- PWA / offline behaviour implications (agents app)?

## Additional Context

Diagrams, mockups, or any other supporting information.
